reviews.comment: Great and caring professor! If you do the work and follow the rubric you will get an A. There is one test and some group projects and then some simple assignments. She brings in guest speakers, and we got to visit radio studios. Super fun class that taught me a lot.

Professor Charner is amazing! If you are interested in broadcast journalism, take this class! If you are thinking this will be an easy elective, it will not be. It is a very hands on class that prepares students to be able to create their own video stories. There are weekly assignments that are super easy, a midterm, and two major video projects.

COMM 365: There are 3 tests that weigh your grade heavily, but aren't too hard. You only get 4 unexcused absences before your grade gets docked, so use those wisely. There is one group project that isn't hard, and then the final is a group project, which isn't hard either. There is a small number of extra credit opportunities, too.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I loved Professor Charner. She genuinely enjoys hearing about her students' career aspirations and wants to help journalism students get connected within the industry. Topics covered in class were actually interesting. You will have a couple (very fun) groups projects and an exam.

This class was by far the most enjoyable and informative class I have ever taken in three years. Professor Charner is seriously the best. You do have to do three presentations which was scary for me at first due to anxiety, but she was so helpful and sweet that I immediately gained so much confidence in my ability to present.

I love this prof! She has lots of experience in journalism. She cares a lot about the content we learn. There are frequent weekly assignments, 1 midterm, and two group projects. Attendance is mandatory but you have several free absences. I left this class with an easy A but with more journalism experience and knowledge. I recommend this class!

Professor Charner is the best of the best. She cares about her students and is passionate about communication and journalism. The class had some weekly assignments that were extremely easy and in-class readings, 1 midterm, 2 group projects, and 1 individual presentation. She also gives really good feedback in all your work.
